name: 2x2 Trade-off Grids
deliverable: Flexible comparative evaluation across two arbitrary orthogonal axes

steps.text: Name the axes; check one does not imply the other.
Label both ends plainly and post them for the room.
Place candidates by arguing each axis in turn.
Rename the quadrants and name each one's action.
Pick one high-risk, high-value bet and name its test.

failure: Correlated axes flatten the grid into a diagonal, every candidate looks alike, and the session decides nothing.
intervention: Test whether high on one axis forces high on the other. If it does, replace the axis with a pressure that truly conflicts.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: Widely used in strategy and design practice; no single documented originator.
